-- SQLite schema for the notes service.
-- Foreign key enforcement must be enabled per connection with
-- "PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON"; app.py does this for every connection.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    title      TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (length(title) BETWEEN 1 AND 120),
    body       TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at TEXT    NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tags (
    id   INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    name TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 30),
    CONSTRAINT uq_tags_name UNIQUE (name)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS note_tags (
    note_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    tag_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (note_id, tag_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (note_id) REFERENCES notes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (tag_id)  REFERENCES tags (id)  ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_note_tags_tag_id ON note_tags (tag_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notes_created_at ON notes (created_at);

```python
"""Notes service: FastAPI + sqlite3."""

import os
import re
import sqlite3
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Optional

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Response
from pydantic import BaseModel

SCHEMA_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().with_name("schema.sql")
TAG_RE = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9]{1,30}")
TITLE_MAX = 120


def db_path() -> str:
    return os.environ.get("NOTES_DB", "notes.db")


def connect() -> sqlite3.Connection:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path())
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    return conn


def init_db() -> None:
    schema = SCHEMA_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    conn = connect()
    try:
        conn.executescript(schema)
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(_app: FastAPI):
    init_db()
    yield


app = FastAPI(title="Notes service", version="1.0.0", lifespan=lifespan)


class NoteIn(BaseModel):
    title: str
    body: Optional[str] = ""
    tags: Optional[List[str]] = None


def utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ")


def validate_note(note: NoteIn):
    title = note.title
    if not 1 <= len(title) <= TITLE_MAX:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail="title must be between 1 and 120 characters",
        )
    body = note.body if note.body is not None else ""
    tags: List[str] = []
    for tag in note.tags or []:
        if not TAG_RE.fullmatch(tag):
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=422,
                detail="tag %r must be 1 to 30 lowercase letters or digits" % tag,
            )
        if tag not in tags:
            tags.append(tag)
    return title, body, tags


def fetch_tags(conn: sqlite3.Connection, note_id: int) -> List[str]:
    rows = conn.execute(
        "SELECT t.name FROM tags t "
        "JOIN note_tags nt ON nt.tag_id = t.id "
        "WHERE nt.note_id = ? ORDER BY t.name",
        (note_id,),
    ).fetchall()
    return [row["name"] for row in rows]


def row_to_note(conn: sqlite3.Connection, row: sqlite3.Row) -> dict:
    return {
        "id": row["id"],
        "title": row["title"],
        "body": row["body"],
        "created_at": row["created_at"],
        "tags": fetch_tags(conn, row["id"]),
    }


def load_note(conn: sqlite3.Connection, note_id: int) -> Optional[dict]:
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, title, body, created_at FROM notes WHERE id = ?",
        (note_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return None
    return row_to_note(conn, row)


@app.post("/notes", status_code=201)
def create_note(note: NoteIn):
    title, body, tags = validate_note(note)
    conn = connect()
    try:
        with conn:
            cur = conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO notes (title, body, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                (title, body, utc_now_iso()),
            )
            note_id = cur.lastrowid
            for name in tags:
                conn.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO tags (name) VALUES (?)", (name,))
                tag_id = conn.execute(
                    "SELECT id FROM tags WHERE name = ?", (name,)
                ).fetchone()["id"]
                conn.execute(
                    "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO note_tags (note_id, tag_id) VALUES (?, ?)",
                    (note_id, tag_id),
                )
        return load_note(conn, note_id)
    finally:
        conn.close()


@app.get("/notes")
def list_notes(tag: Optional[str] = None):
    conn = connect()
    try:
        if tag is None:
            rows = conn.execute(
                "SELECT id, title, body, created_at FROM notes "
                "ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC"
            ).fetchall()
        else:
            rows = conn.execute(
                "SELECT n.id, n.title, n.body, n.created_at FROM notes n "
                "JOIN note_tags nt ON nt.note_id = n.id "
                "JOIN tags t ON t.id = nt.tag_id "
                "WHERE t.name = ? "
                "ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC",
                (tag,),
            ).fetchall()
        return [row_to_note(conn, row) for row in rows]
    finally:
        conn.close()


@app.get("/notes/{note_id}")
def get_note(note_id: int):
    conn = connect()
    try:
        note = load_note(conn, note_id)
    finally:
        conn.close()
    if note is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="note not found")
    return note


@app.delete("/notes/{note_id}", status_code=204, response_class=Response)
def delete_note(note_id: int):
    conn = connect()
    try:
        with conn:
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM note_tags WHERE note_id = ?", (note_id,))
            cur = conn.execute("DELETE FROM notes WHERE id = ?", (note_id,))
            deleted = cur.rowcount
    finally:
        conn.close()
    if deleted == 0:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="note not found")
    return Response(status_code=204)
```

import sqlite3

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app import app


@pytest.fixture
def db_file(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    path = tmp_path / "test_notes.db"
    monkeypatch.setenv("NOTES_DB", str(path))
    return path


@pytest.fixture
def client(db_file):
    with TestClient(app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def create(client, title="A note", body="", tags=None):
    payload = {"title": title, "body": body, "tags": tags or []}
    return client.post("/notes", json=payload)


def count_rows(db_file, table):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(str(db_file))
    try:
        return conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM %s" % table).fetchone()[0]
    finally:
        conn.close()


def test_create_note(client):
    resp = create(client, title="Hello", body="World", tags=["work", "idea1"])
    assert resp.status_code == 201
    data = resp.json()
    assert isinstance(data["id"], int)
    assert data["title"] == "Hello"
    assert data["body"] == "World"
    assert sorted(data["tags"]) == ["idea1", "work"]
    assert data["created_at"].endswith("Z")
    assert "T" in data["created_at"]


def test_create_note_without_body_or_tags(client):
    resp = client.post("/notes", json={"title": "Only title"})
    assert resp.status_code == 201
    data = resp.json()
    assert data["body"] == ""
    assert data["tags"] == []


def test_get_note(client):
    created = create(client, title="Get me", tags=["x"]).json()
    resp = client.get("/notes/%d" % created["id"])
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json() == created


def test_get_missing_note_returns_404(client):
    resp = client.get("/notes/9999")
    assert resp.status_code == 404


def test_list_all_newest_first(client):
    first = create(client, title="first").json()
    second = create(client, title="second").json()
    third = create(client, title="third").json()
    resp = client.get("/notes")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    ids = [note["id"] for note in resp.json()]
    assert ids == [third["id"], second["id"], first["id"]]


def test_list_by_tag(client):
    a = create(client, title="a", tags=["red"]).json()
    create(client, title="b", tags=["blue"])
    c = create(client, title="c", tags=["red", "blue"]).json()
    resp = client.get("/notes", params={"tag": "red"})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    ids = [note["id"] for note in resp.json()]
    assert ids == [c["id"], a["id"]]
    assert client.get("/notes", params={"tag": "green"}).json() == []


def test_tags_are_stored_once(client, db_file):
    create(client, title="one", tags=["shared", "shared"])
    create(client, title="two", tags=["shared"])
    assert count_rows(db_file, "tags") == 1
    assert count_rows(db_file, "note_tags") == 2


def test_delete_note(client, db_file):
    created = create(client, title="bye", tags=["gone"]).json()
    resp = client.delete("/notes/%d" % created["id"])
    assert resp.status_code == 204
    assert resp.content == b""
    assert client.get("/notes/%d" % created["id"]).status_code == 404
    assert client.get("/notes", params={"tag": "gone"}).json() == []
    assert count_rows(db_file, "note_tags") == 0


def test_delete_missing_note_returns_404(client):
    resp = client.delete("/notes/12345")
    assert resp.status_code == 404


def test_empty_title_returns_422(client):
    assert create(client, title="").status_code == 422


def test_missing_title_returns_422(client):
    assert client.post("/notes", json={"body": "no title"}).status_code == 422


def test_long_title_returns_422(client):
    assert create(client, title="x" * 121).status_code == 422
    assert create(client, title="x" * 120).status_code == 201


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "bad_tag",
    ["", "Upper", "has space", "dash-tag", "a" * 31, "ünï"],
)
def test_invalid_tag_returns_422(client, bad_tag):
    resp = create(client, title="tagged", tags=[bad_tag])
    assert resp.status_code == 422


def test_invalid_request_does_not_create_note(client):
    create(client, title="ok", tags=["BAD"])
    assert client.get("/notes").json() == []


def test_valid_tag_boundaries(client):
    resp = create(client, title="tags", tags=["a", "b" * 30, "abc123"])
    assert resp.status_code == 201
    assert sorted(resp.json()["tags"]) == sorted(["a", "b" * 30, "abc123"])
